title: Moist Dutch Omelette
description: A simple yet satisfying vegetarian omelette made with eggs and a hint of Dutch flavor.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, beat the eggs together with a fork.
2. Heat a small non-stick pan over medium heat and add the Gouda cheese.
3. Once the cheese has melted, pour in the eggs and sprinkle with Mozzarella cheese.
4. Tilt the pan to evenly distribute the eggs and cheese.
5. Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
6. Continue cooking for another 2-3 minutes, until the eggs are almost set.
7. Sprinkle with chopped chives and season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Fold the omelette in half and cook for an additional 30 seconds.
9. Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate and serve hot.
10. Enjoy your delicious moist Dutch omelette!
